slots.notes: Fullscreen looping background video, object-fit cover, autoplay muted playsInline; sits at z-index 0 under a warm rgba(242,238,230,0.38) off-white tint, so it should read soft/muted for dark-brown text legibility.

mechanic: A single static full-viewport section centers a warm-dark-brown headline and a map-pin captioned subtext over a fullscreen looping background video veiled by a warm off-white tint, with no scroll, parallax, or entrance motion.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS, but the about.tsx component itself is styled entirely with inline styles (no Tailwind utility classes in the component); fonts loaded via onlinewebfonts <link>/@import in index.html and index.css.
